# Synthetic MS workflow fixtures

All files are invented software-test data, not instrument measurements.

- `synthetic-centroids.csv`: five-entry smoke fixture.
- `invalid-negative.csv`: deliberate input rejection.
- `synthetic-inspection-spectrum.csv`: 1,007 entries spanning a broad display range, with artificial peak clusters, background entries, one repeated m/z and one zero intensity. Generated once using seed 20261030. It demonstrates spectrum inspection and workflow checks; it is not a validated isotope model or a protein identification benchmark.

No partner, patient or proprietary laboratory data is included.
